text._0: >根本原因：`Package.resolved` 将 swift-collections 锁死
在 1.1.0 版本，但新目标导入了在 1.1.3 中添加的

`swift package update swift-collections` 升级锁定的版本。</translation>

testCase.input: Root cause: `Package.resolved` pins swift-collections 1.1.0, but the new target imports `OrderedSet` APIs that were added in 1.1.3. CI uses the lockfile, so it fails there while local builds float to the newer version. Bump the pin with `swift package update swift-collections`.
